notes.title: Release 1.0-7
notes.content:
Changes since 1.0-6:

Fix issue with loading saved games using demo wizard
Apply movement limits to selection rectangle within map view
Some minor changes in preparation for future update

This update is available for Windows and Linux only. MacOS remains on version 1.0-6 until the next release is published.

notes.title: Release 1.0-6
notes.content:
Changes since 1.0-4:

Fix unable to use Scroll of Awe
Text improvements on Inventory screen
Add missing icon from inventory button for flying creatures
Corrected text size on spell school selection screen

notes.title: Release 1.0-4
notes.content:
Changes since 1.0-3:

Added AP use counter, you can now see the actual cost of making a move before committing to it.
Fix for potential lock-up in background processing, which caused the opponent turn to never end.

notes.title: Release 1.0-3
notes.content:
Replaced font to improve legibility.
Added spell duration ranges to details in the spell library selection window.
Performance improvements.

notes.title: Release 0.98-3
notes.content:
This is a fairly large update and introduces the final major feature, riding (mounts). All trials have unique music tracks, and progress to a 1.0 release is near.


Mounts
Music track for the Trial of Clouds
Music track for the Trial of Faes' Lake
Music track for the Trial of Succession
Map fix for small issue of the Trial of Alleys
Fix potential crash during opponent's turn after the portal has appeared
Fix issue with door lock state over saved games
Fix random crash
Fix potential game freeze during opponent's turn

notes.title: Release 0.97-10
notes.content:
Changes since 0.97-9:

Cantrips are now available (after a spell school is joined at level two).
AI enhancements.
Corrected the default value of Warding for a new wizard.
Additional status icons for the new modifiers introduced over the last few updates.
Fixed incorrect display of opponent display for the Trial of Succession.
Fixed rare but random crash to desktop.
Fixed crash resulting from casting Befriend on a wizard.


Cantrips

Cantrips are special spells that can be cast without needing to use slots in the spellbook. Each spell school grants a specific cantrip. The cantrip associated with the school joined at level two can be cast once per turn. The cantrip associated with the second school (joined at level five) can be cast once every other turn.

notes.title: Update 0.96-2
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30565495/d77e4c580a1f9a065acf58ecbf96c88430cbf4df.png
More improvements on spell effectiveness and balance, including a much improved success chance for the Hold spell.
Some creatures other than wizards can now use potions from their inventory.
You'll now have a minimum of one library slot unlock available on trial completion, so you can go mad with reverse-engineering all the things if you want to.
And a pass on all trials to fix some issues with doors starting open that should be closed.

notes.title: 0.96 - The Achievements Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30565495/2b8c44ef418e7e9453eddfc306a783d95ee00911.jpg
This is a big one!
We've added Steam achievements!
There's more wizards. There's more creatures.
There's been art and balance passes on nearly every trial.
There's now a combat log that will give you very useful feedback on gribbly fights.
Flying creatures can now move over indoor chasms (hovering).
There's now active defence mechanics, so saved action points provide extra defence to a creature or wizard out of its turn.
There's a new tier 4 trial: The Trial of Faes' Lake. This one is hard as nails so good luck.
Did I mention Steam achievements!?

Full changelog here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/638060/discussions/1/1635237606659252292/

notes.content:

Auto-targeting between flying and grounded targets. (Yay!)

notes.title: Update 0.95-8
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30565495/16578f14f5ed6f7fe42fc1d214c0a8af545a4c7f.png
Lots of little UI improvements in today's update. Spell damage has been revised, restoring effectiveness that was reduced by the melee changes in our last update. There's now more hints, covering some basic gameplay when you first enter a trial, and a bunch of small bug fixes you don't need to care about.

notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30565495/05d1ad4e3e678e2515a503c17ace11a3c6edd137.png
We've started to add some hints to help those new to the game for creating their Wizard and beginning  their ascension to the ranks of the Majestic Few. 
We've given the Trial of Troglodytes a thorough polish and re-balance so you actually choose it over The Trial of Dagger Docks. 
The Trial of Ledges got a makeover and balance pass. 
An annoying cave corner in the Trial of Talon Tower got fixed.
Enjoy!
